quests.title: The Water Station Route
quests.description: A caravan factor working the water stations is short after a bad crossing.
quests.synopsis: Mara Veln trades straight and pays favors back with interest. Her wagons are short on medicine and axle parts; what you do about that is the first entry in her ledger.

choices.text: Hand over medicine and axle parts at a fair price.
choices.consequences: She writes the favor into her ledger and tells you the route she will run in spring. The entry does not say what it will be worth by then.

choices.text: Buy her shortage at a premium.
choices.consequences: The cargo is cheap and the wagon leaves light. She prices your next transaction correctly, which is to say: completely.

quests.title: Wreckage on the Cut Road
quests.description: The caravan factor's second wagon is through the road crust, and she is camped on the wreck.
quests.synopsis: The route took its toll. Whether she remembers you as a creditor, a stranger, or the one who handed over the antibiotics decides how this meeting goes.

choices.text: Pull the wagon out and walk her people to the caravanserai.
choices.consequences: It costs a day and a half of water. She does not thank you. She recalculates your standing in her ledger, and the new number is better.

choices.text: Trade for what is loose and leave the wreck to the road.
choices.consequences: You get cargo. She gets the kind of story about you that travels faster than caravans.

quests.title: The Coordinator's Stamp
quests.description: The grain exchange has given Mara Veln the southern routes.
quests.synopsis: She runs the routes now, from a desk with a stamp. The rate sheet has a line for friends of the coordinator. Your name is either on it or in a different column.

choices.text: Book caravan space at the coordinator's rate.
choices.consequences: The wagons run on time and the price holds. Somewhere in the exchange a ledger line has your name in it, entered in a hand you recognize.
